name: PHL-03 multiple rocket launcher
overview_md:
The PHL-03 is the PLA's heavy 300 mm multiple rocket launcher — a Chinese development closely modelled on Russia's BM-30 Smerch, and for years the long-range area-fire backbone of Chinese group-army artillery. It bridges the gap between divisional tube and rocket artillery and the newer, longer-range guided PHL-191, providing massed firepower at operational depth.

Mounted on a heavy 8×8 truck, the PHL-03 carries twelve 300 mm rockets and can saturate a target area at ranges from roughly 70 km out to around 130 km with extended and fire-correction rounds. A single battery delivers a devastating volume of fire against troop concentrations, airfields, logistics hubs and other soft or area targets, and the system has been widely exported (as the A100/AR2 family) to a range of customers.

For an analyst, the PHL-03 represents the PLA's earlier generation of long-range rocket fires — proven, numerous and still capable, even as the modular guided PHL-191 takes over the cutting edge with far greater range and precision. Together they give Chinese ground forces a deep, layered rocket-artillery capability, from the saturating area fire of the PHL-03 to the precision long-range strike of the PHL-191.

combat_history.event: No combat use; long the long-range rocket backbone of PLA group-army artillery and widely exported.
combat_history.significance: Capability assessed from fielding and exports.

modernization.description: The guided modular PHL-191 takes the cutting edge while the PHL-03 remains in service.
modernization.impact: Layers proven area fire with new precision long-range fires.

vulnerabilities.description: Large signature on firing; vulnerable if static.
Largely an area weapon with dispersion.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Massed long-range area rocket fire at operational depth for group-army artillery.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Group-army artillery brigades; complemented by the guided PHL-191.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: The PHL-03 is China's Smerch-class 300 mm MLRS.
The PHL-191 offers far greater range, modularity and precision; the PHL-03 is the proven area-fire predecessor.
India's lighter 214 mm system; the PHL-03 is heavier and longer-ranged.

doctrine.role: Heavy 300 mm multiple rocket launcher for massed long-range area fire.
doctrine.employment: Saturating rocket salvos against area and soft targets at operational depth.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Proven Smerch-class area fire — volume over precision.
doctrine.threat_context: The earlier generation of PLA long-range rocket fires, layered with the guided PHL-191.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against Russia's Smerch (parent), China's PHL-191 (successor) and India's Pinaka.
